item.title: Bulletin updated at 08:50 HKT 23/Feb/2026
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The easterly airstream is expected to persist over the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. The weather will be relatively humid over the region and warm during the day. With a trough of low pressure developing over central China midweek this week and gradually edging closer to the coastal areas of Guangdong, there will be occasional showers over the region in the latter part of this week, and there may be isolated thunderstorms. The northeast monsoon will affect southern China gradually early next week, temperatures will fall slightly over the region.
